title: Monad bills the gas limit
lesson: A transaction pays gas_limit times price. The price does not fall below 100 gwei. Unused gas is not refunded. A revert pays the whole limit. A quote that ignores the limit is not a profit.

title: The rebalancer keeps looking
lesson: runner/rebalancer-seek.mjs signs with the rebalancer key only when a fresh Monad simulation clears 0.005 MON after the gas limit, eth_call still succeeds 15000 gas under that limit, the limit is at most 800000, the size is at most 2 MON, both pools cover their reserves, and the wallet stays at or above 5 MON. A pending showcase transaction skips the tick. A revert ends the process. The schedule is minute 15 of each hour, then about every 4 seconds for 35 minutes. No top-up is required at 96.456732959 MON. A 50 MON top-up toward 150 MON is a buffer for showcase gas and one reverted limit. The buffer was not sent. The clip cap and the 600 second round are unchanged.

title: What the desk still does
lesson: A quote is not a send. The signer sends when the settled gain is larger than the limit on the transaction, after eth_call, because a revert bills that limit. Clip gas stays 420,000. Rough gas on the spread desk stays half a million gas at 100 gwei. The signing wallet keeps 5 MON. Rounds stay ten minutes apart. A round sends at most 20 clips. There is no promised rate.
